verdict.rationale: Gemini in Gmail can be asked to organize mail, such as adding labels or deleting multiple emails (gmail-docs-14). That is a prompt-steered AI labeling capability, but it is on-demand rather than autonomous inbox triage. Rule-based filters (gmail-docs-15, gmail-docs-28) are not AI and get no credit, and thread summarization (gmail-docs-13) is an adjacent feature rather than triage. Missing for 10: automatic AI labeling/categorization of incoming mail, AI surfacing of what needs attention, a way to audit the AI's triage decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
